attributes.accessibilityText: SPECTER covert channel extracts data from air-gapped computers

attributes.text: SPECTER uses USB power-management and device-state controls to exfiltrate data from air-gapped Windows 10 and Ubuntu 22.04 systems. It requires root or administrator privileges, toggles USB devices to generate signals, and achieves 0.2–1 bit per second via smartphone charging status, peripheral behaviour or electromagnetic emissions. The channel can transmit small files such as cryptographic keys and credentials, but may trigger notifications or interrupt peripherals.
Tip: Monitor USB state changes and enforce physical security around isolated systems.
